title: Concrete Root-Uptake Crop-State Provider Readiness

primary_blocker.owner: F-WOF / Crop, ET and root-uptake physics
required_semantics: root geometry sufficient to determine rooted nodes
current root-distribution state or derived cumulative root-fraction view

secondary_blocker.missing_contract: explicit current potential-transpiration result supplied at root-uptake evaluation
secondary_blocker.reason: ptra is a current ET process result and may vary within the day; it must not be smuggled into persistent crop state

release_conditions: define and qualify a runtime-independent crop-root state snapshot/view contract
define the current potential-transpiration input/result ownership explicitly
prove their assembly occurs at the intended root-uptake evaluation point
preserve legacy B1.10 root-update ordering where that cadence remains part of the admitted reference physics
prove transaction/retry semantics do not advance crop/root state on rejected trials
keep inactive crop free of root-distribution state allocation
do not read MOD_meteo, MOD_cropdevelopment, plant_interface or other legacy globals from production provider code
next: Start a separate F-WOF-owned explicit crop-root state snapshot / root-uptake input assembly seam. Keep potential_transpiration an explicit dynamic ET input rather than persistent crop state.
